process.title: How it works
process.lead: Here is what working with EQUIS looks like. Assessments and plans are handled directly with your coach as part of the service.

steps.title: Tell us about your goal
steps.text: Send a short consultation enquiry with your goal and how you would like us to contact you.

steps.title: Discuss your needs
steps.text: We talk through your goal, routine and whether EQUIS coaching is a good fit for you.

steps.title: Complete your assessment
steps.text: If we work together, you complete the appropriate assessment directly with your coach as part of the coaching service.

steps.title: Receive your structure
steps.text: You receive an individualized nutrition and/or training structure designed around your life.

steps.title: Review and adjust
steps.text: You review progress with your coach and the approach is adjusted as you go.

process.note: Please do not send medical or health details through this website. Anything your coach needs will be collected directly during the coaching process.

approach.title: Nutrition and training as one system

approach.title: Realistic and respectful
approach.text: No shame, no fear tactics and no miracle claims.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Can't find your answer? Ask us in your consultation enquiry.

items.a: EQUIS is for people who want to work toward a body-shape goal — fat loss, muscle gain or body recomposition — with practical nutrition and gym-aligned support. Many of our clients are busy professionals and gym-focused people.

items.q: Can I join if I have a busy work schedule?
items.a: Yes. Coaching is built around your real routine, including your working hours and the time you actually have for training and meals.

items.q: Do I need a gym membership?
items.a: EQUIS coaching is designed around gym-aligned training. Tell us about your current training setup in your enquiry and we will discuss what fits you during your consultation.
Yes. Nutrition is individualized to your goal, routine and food preferences after you complete your assessment with your coach.
Practical food choices are central to our approach, so plans take into account the foods you enjoy and can easily find. You can discuss your preferences with your coach.
Coaching format and availability are confirmed during your consultation. Mention your country and preferred way of working in your enquiry.

items.q: What happens after I submit the consultation form?
items.a: We review your enquiry and contact you using your preferred method to discuss your goal and whether EQUIS is the right fit. Submitting an enquiry does not commit you to anything.

p: This website is operated by EQUIS Nutrition, a nutrition and training coaching brand led by {founder}.
If you send a consultation enquiry, we collect only the details you choose to provide: your name, email address and/or phone number, country, main goal, preferred contact method and a short message.
We do not ask for, and ask you not to send, medical history, medications, allergies, body measurements, photos or other health information through this website.
We use your enquiry only to respond to you and discuss whether our coaching is a good fit. We do not sell your information or use it for unrelated marketing.
Your enquiry is sent securely to EQUIS through an email or form-delivery service provider acting on our behalf. Enquiry contents are not written to website logs or analytics.
The website stores a small cookie to remember your language preference. We do not use advertising cookies.
We keep enquiry details only for as long as needed to respond to you and to meet any legal obligations.
You can ask us to access, correct or delete the information you sent us by contacting us through the contact page.
We may update this policy. The latest version will always be published on this page.
This website provides general information about EQUIS Nutrition and its coaching services, and lets you send a consultation enquiry.

Content on this website is general information and is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. If you have a medical condition, are pregnant, or take medication, speak with a qualified healthcare professional before changing your diet or training.
Individual results vary and depend on many factors. Nothing on this website is a promise of a specific outcome or timeline.
Sending an enquiry does not create a coaching agreement. Any coaching service is agreed separately and directly with EQUIS.
The EQUIS name, logo and website content belong to EQUIS Nutrition and may not be copied or reused without permission.
We may update these terms. The latest version will always be published on this page.
